list.name: Scraper failures
list.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       COALESCE(finished_at, started_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS time_end,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(left(error, 160), ''), 'run failed') AS text
FROM reporting.scrape_health
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

description: What is on the market right now: supply, asking prices, fresh listings and price drops — for the current filter selection.

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Seen by a scrape in the last 14 days and not closed. Respects every filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
)
SELECT count(*) AS active,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS new_7d,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_rent AND ppm2 > 0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE is_rent AND price > 0) AS median_rent
FROM base

panels.title: New · 7 d
panels.description: Active listings first seen in the last week — fresh supply.

panels.title: Price drops · 7 d
panels.description: Distinct listings with an observed price decrease in the last 7 days; includes listings that later closed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT pc.article_id) AS dropped
FROM reporting.price_changes_filtered(
  now() - INTERVAL '7 days', now(),
  ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[],
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}),
  ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
  ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[],
  ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) pc
WHERE pc.delta < 0

panels.title: Median rent · KM/mo
panels.description: Median monthly asking rent among rental listings matching the filters.

panels.title: Median asking KM/m² — daily snapshots, with p25–p75 band
panels.description: Pooled reconstructed daily inventory asking prices for the selected period. Percentiles are NULL when no eligible priced rows exist; sample, estimated, stale and provisional columns expose data quality.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       p25 AS "p25 KM/m2",
       median AS "median KM/m2",
       p75 AS "p75 KM/m2",
       inventory_count AS "inventory",
       priced_count AS "priced sample",
       estimated_count AS "estimated",
       stale_count AS "stale",
       provisional_day AS "provisional"
FROM reporting.market_daily_filtered(
  date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
  ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[],
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}),
  ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
  ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS t(selected)),
  ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active sale listings by rooms
panels.description: Sale side of the current filter selection.

panels.title: Inventory flow — new vs closed per day · all categories
panels.description: All categories and deals. New counts each article once on its first discovery date; repeated sightings and renewals are not additions. Closed and reopened count lifecycle events. Active inventory is reconstructed and may include inferred or stale observations; today is provisional.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       new_n AS "new", closed_n AS "closed", reopened_n AS "reopened",
       active_est AS "active (est)", stale_n AS "stale", provisional_day AS "provisional"
FROM reporting.market_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
              AND date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Stalest active listings — oldest creation day first
panels.description: Age measured from the ad's creation day (olx publish date; falls back to our first sighting). renewed_day is the seller's last bump — NULL until the renewal backfill converges; an old renewed_day means the ad has stopped competing for attention.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.price, l.ppm2,
       (COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS created_day,
       (l.renewed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS renewed_day,
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen))) / 86400.0)::int AS days_online
FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
WHERE reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY COALESCE(l.published_at, l.first_seen) ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Listing map — click a pin to open the ad
panels.description: Pins of active listings placed by their ad's map coordinates; respects every filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT latitude, longitude, title, url, price, sqm, rooms, ppm2, location AS location, last_seen
FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL

panels.description: The 100 most recently seen pinned listings — companion table to the map. Click a title to open the ad on olx.ba.

panels.title: Best value — lowest KM/m² (sales)
panels.description: Cheapest per m² among sale listings matching the filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.location, l.rooms, l.sqm, l.price, l.ppm2
FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.ppm2 > 0
  AND reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY l.ppm2 ASC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent price drops — newest first
panels.description: Observed price decreases in the last 30 days, filtered by event-time attributes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, pc.prior_price AS was, pc.price AS now,
       (pc.prior_price - pc.price) AS drop, pc.effective_at AS seen
FROM reporting.price_changes_filtered(
  now() - INTERVAL '30 days', now(),
  ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[],
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
  reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}),
  ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
  ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[],
  ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) pc
JOIN reporting.dashboard_listings l ON l.article_id = pc.article_id
WHERE pc.delta < 0
ORDER BY pc.effective_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Price vs m² — sales
panels.description: Sale asking price against floor area for the selected listings, with a least-squares fit over the same population. Prices below the fit can reflect location, condition or data quality; they do not establish a bargain.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT sqm::float8 AS sqm, price::float8 AS price
  FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
  WHERE NOT is_rent AND price IS NOT NULL AND ppm2 > 0 AND sqm > 0
), fit AS (
  SELECT min(sqm) AS x0, max(sqm) AS x1, regr_slope(price, sqm) AS slope, regr_intercept(price, sqm) AS intercept FROM base
), plotted AS (
  SELECT 'Listings'::text AS series, sqm, price AS price_km FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Regression', (x0 + (x1 - x0) * gs / 80.0)::float8,
         round(intercept + slope * (x0 + (x1 - x0) * gs / 80.0))::double precision
  FROM fit CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 80) gs WHERE slope IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT series, sqm, price_km FROM plotted
ORDER BY CASE series WHEN 'Listings' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sqm

panels.title: Actives that cut their price
panels.description: Active listings whose history contains at least one observed decrease — negotiation leverage exists here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT article_id FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
), cuts AS (
  SELECT article_id, max(-delta) AS biggest
  FROM reporting.price_changes
  WHERE delta < 0 AND deal = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS t(selected)))
  GROUP BY article_id
), matched AS (
  SELECT cuts.biggest FROM base JOIN cuts USING (article_id)
)
SELECT count(*) AS actives,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY biggest) AS median_biggest
FROM matched

panels.title: Annualized asking rent / sale ratio
panels.description: Annualized asking-rent / asking-sale-price ratio within the Category, Rooms, Area and Neighborhood filters; ignores Deal because both populations are needed. Assumes monthly rents and does not match individual properties or estimate net returns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.price) AS p
  FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[]::text[]) l
  WHERE NOT l.is_rent AND l.price > 0
    AND reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
r AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.price) AS p
  FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[]::text[]) l
  WHERE l.is_rent AND l.price > 0
    AND reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
)
SELECT round((r.p * 12 / s.p * 100)::numeric, 1)::double precision AS gross_yield_pct
FROM s, r

panels.title: Median KM/m² · sales — this week vs last
panels.description: Pooled eligible listing-day asking prices from reconstructed daily inventory, comparing this week with last week. Empty priced populations remain NULL; filters apply to historical category, deal, room, area and neighborhood state.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pooled AS (
  SELECT d.day, d.ppm2
  FROM reporting.daily_listing_facts_olap d
  WHERE d.price_state = 'valid' AND d.ppm2 IS NOT NULL AND d.deal = 'sale'
    AND d.day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7
    AND d.day < date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date + 7

  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
    OR d.category_memberships && ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]
    OR d.category = ANY (ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]))
  AND (reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}) IS NULL OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm >= reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}))
  AND (reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}) IS NULL OR d.sqm IS NULL OR d.sqm <= reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
    OR d.rooms = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR d.room_bucket = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[]))
  AND (CASE WHEN d.deal = 'rent' THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sale' END) = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS t(selected)))
  AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
    OR d.neighborhood = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[])
    OR d.location = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]))
), weeks AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS "this wk",
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE day >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7
                   AND day < date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS "last wk"
  FROM pooled
)
SELECT "this wk"::int AS "this wk",
       "last wk"::int AS "last wk",
       round((100.0 * ("this wk" - "last wk") / NULLIF("last wk", 0))::numeric, 1)::double precision AS "Δ %"
FROM weeks

panels.title: Median KM/m² by floor position · sales
panels.description: Median sale asking KM/m² by floor position, with the priced sample size in each label. Listings without floor information are excluded.

panels.title: Asking KM/m² by seller · sales
panels.description: Private sellers vs agencies ('shop') vs ads where the type wasn't captured. Seller type rides along with every search result, so coverage here is high — one of the biggest price drivers, finally visible.

panels.title: Districts ranked — median asking KM/m² · sales
panels.description: Where is it expensive: every district with ≥8 sale listings, ranked by median asking price per m² with the p25–p75 spread. Deliberately ignores the Neighborhood filter (so all districts stay comparable); Category/Rooms/Deal still apply. Districts come from map pins (db/init/09-neighborhood-data.sql).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS neighborhood,
       count(*) AS listings,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.ppm2)::int AS "median KM/m2"
FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
WHERE reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Neighborhood breakdown — actives
panels.description: Active listing counts and available asking KM/m² by recorded neighborhood. Missing pins and unmapped locations are shown separately.

panels.title: Most viewed active listings
panels.description: Pregledi counter from ad pages — what everyone else is watching (where exposed).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.views, l.sqm, l.rooms, l.price, l.ppm2
FROM reporting.overview_listings_filtered(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
WHERE l.views IS NOT NULL AND reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY l.views DESC
LIMIT 20
